description.describe_ch: 本課程強調跨領域整合職能的培養，主張藝術與設計需因應數位世代不同領域之需求，結合各方面的資源並應用在實作中，以多元實作整合的方式，才能真正幫助學生啟動創意潛能，同時，培養其在未來職場上真正需要的5C關鍵能力。實作過程將根據需要整合各種不同的藝術與科技技術。
description.describe_eh: The emphasis of the class is in interdisciplinary collaborative professional development. The design of this curriculum advocates for the needs of engagement of art and design with the various domains of the digital age while integrating with all resources available applied to implementation so as to provide substantial assistance to cultivate creative potentials of students, as well as the critical 5C capabilities genuinely needed in future vocational domains. The actual implementation of the course will integrate the various arts and technologies.
